notes: No code changed in this seat: 0ceaeb1 already holds the fix, and this seat verified it. Gaps for the owner, outside this task's scope: (1) Idempotency: each `cma case preview` appends a new preview entry, even for an identical snapshot. This is intended as an audit record, but a sign-off (T27) should bind to the latest preview's snapshot, not to 'a preview exists'. (2) A firm memo_fields.yaml whose field titles hold digits (e.g. 'Q3 trading') fails the guard, because titles are read. That matches R28's refusal of literal numbers, but the field-map validator does not warn at load. A design choice: refuse digits in titles, or blank titles in the guard copy. (3) Observability/operability: no remote alerting by design. The signals are exit 1 for an ungrounded preview and the case-log entry with grounded/policy_check. No runbook or changelog line was written. Performance was not measured: one case_figures call per preview, in a hot path only R52 times (T22). (4) Authz: the command relies on the case root's owner-only permissions (R31), as every other `cma case` command does. There is no separate check.
